summary: S3Connection is the leaf connection for S3-family stores (AWS, S3 Express, R2, MinIO, B2). connect() lazily imports boto3 and either creates boto3.client('s3', **kwargs) from flat kwargs or, for a Session envelope, builds a boto3 Session from a named profile, explicit keys or ambient credentials and optionally wraps it with botocore assume-role refreshable credentials.
key_classes: S3Connection — ConnectionProtocol leaf owning a boto3 S3 client
key_functions: S3Connection.connect() -> Self — lazy boto3 import, flat or session-envelope client construction

S3Connection._build_via_session(boto3) — named profile / explicit keys / ambient source session, then STS AssumeRole via AssumeRoleCredentialFetcher + DeferredRefreshableCredentials when role_arn is set
extension_points: Envelope contract with connections._emit_kwargs: keys client_config, session, role_arn, session_name
lifecycle_notes: boto3 is imported in connect(), so the module imports on a base install; missing boto3 raises TransportConnectionError naming [s3].
Assume-role credentials are deferred and refreshed by botocore; the RoleSessionName defaults to 'mountainash-transport'.
Creating a boto3 client performs no network I/O; credential and endpoint failures surface on the first backend operation.
__enter__ returns self without connecting; __exit__ disconnects and attaches cleanup failures as notes when the body raised.
documentation_hooks: S3 credentials guide: explicit keys vs named AWS profile vs ambient vs assume-role
Flavor restrictions: ROLE_ARN only for aws/express
risks: Missing boto3 raises TransportConnectionError rather than MissingExtraError, inconsistent with the package's missing-extra convention (AGENTS.md Dependencies).
Assume-role path sets the private botocore attribute target._credentials (type: ignore), which can break on botocore upgrades.
Specifying both PROFILE_NAME and explicit keys raises ValueError at connect time rather than at profile validation.
ValueError and TransportConnectionError propagate unwrapped while all other exceptions are wrapped, so callers see mixed exception types from connect().
open_questions: Should a missing boto3 raise MissingExtraError('s3') for consistency?

evidence.detail: _emit_kwargs builds the session envelope and rejects ROLE_ARN for r2/minio/b2
